activities.name: Authentication and account association
activities.purpose: Authenticate a learner and associate a session with the correct account record.
data_categories: identity claims such as name/email where received
activities.guardian_process: Required where child-data processing/service access requires it; verify before use

activities.name: Learner profile, preferences and progress persistence
activities.purpose: Restore learner-selected profile, settings, course continuity and progress.
recipients_and_access: Supabase and authorised provider personnel under applicable contract
activities.guardian_process: Child-access gate and required guardian permission must be verified
activities.risk_and_dpia: Child-data DPIA and live database review required

activities.name: Diagnostics, learning analysis and adaptive recommendations
activities.purpose: Provide course diagnostics, identify learning needs and select learning recommendations.
activities.source: Learner responses and deterministic application logic
activities.guardian_process: Child eligibility and required guardian permission must be verified
activities.risk_and_dpia: Potential child profiling; Article 19 counsel decision and DPIA required before enablement

activities.name: Session-only Study Guide and local commands
activities.purpose: Respond to supported deterministic commands using current session context.
activities.retention_rule: Session expiry and provider log retention are unverified
activities.risk_and_dpia: Verify whether prompts/session identifiers enter logs or persistence

activities.name: Optional external AI tutoring
activities.purpose: Generate open-ended tutoring explanations when the learner separately enables the feature.
data_categories: up to eight selected prior AI tutoring messages if separately enabled
limited learning summary if separately enabled
activities.source: Learner messages and selected application context
recipients_and_access: Exact provider is not identified in this template

activities.rights_route: Private data-rights request procedure plus provider route where applicable

activities.name: Hosting, security, operational and backup processing
activities.purpose: Operate, secure, monitor, troubleshoot and recover the service.
